subject.title: docs(gateway): add launchd supervisor loop troubleshooting

question: Should OpenClaw publish this docs-first launchd recovery runbook before generated-wrapper and doctor/install fixes land?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and docs-only, but it recommends operator launchd mutations that can affect node-service availability, so automation should not decide that product tradeoff.

options.title: Land Docs-First Runbook
options.body: Publish the recovery steps with the skip warning while leaving durable runtime and doctor/install hardening tracked in the linked issue.

options.title: Hold For Runtime Fix
options.body: Defer or close this docs PR until generated-wrapper behavior or doctor/install repair lands so users are not asked to carry a manual workaround.

options.title: Require Narrower Wording
options.body: Ask for stricter prerequisites around when disabling the node LaunchAgent is acceptable before merge.

recommendation.title: Land Docs-First Runbook
recommendation.body: Publish the recovery steps with the skip warning while leaving durable runtime and doctor/install hardening tracked in the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the docs, launchd, service-env, and mac app surfaces involved in the product choice.
